summary: M.S. in Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Built machine learning systems across NLP and LLMs, including a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch and 8-bit quantized TinyLlama benchmarks, and shipped real-time inference pipelines with TensorRT (5.2x speedup) and sub-500ms intent classification. Profiled performance bottlenecks across ML internships spanning NLP, computer vision, and research.

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API; added domain-specific special tokens and resized decoder embedding layer accordingly.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom toothbrush detection dataset for health-level classification using YOLOv8.
Trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 annotated images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation; exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Trained U-Net segmentation with VGG-16, VGG-19, and ResNet-50 backbones; evaluated on Dice Score and IoU; reported accuracy-latency trade-offs for deployment.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Designed a custom wavelet bank (alpha-blended sym6+bior3.5) to suppress low-frequency noise; combined with optimized homography stitching and concurrency to achieve a PSNR of 86.

projects.name: GPT-2 Style Language Model from Scratch
bullets: Implemented a GPT-2 style Transformer from scratch in PyTorch: multi-head self-attention, MLP blocks, residual connections, layer norm, and weight tying.
Built a TikToken-based tokenizer wrapper and custom training loop with early stopping and perplexity evaluation.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B LLM; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency across prompt types using pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; <1% accuracy degradation with +0.09 perplexity increase — near-lossless compression.

projects.name: COFFIN – Whisper-Style ASR from Scratch
bullets: Achieved 15% WER on the NPTEL 2020 Indian-English dataset while reducing preprocessing latency via optimized tokenization.

Built an end-to-end ASR pipeline: 80-channel mel spectrogram encoder, 4-block causal Transformer decoder with cross-attention, trained on 1,000 Indian-English samples (NPTEL 2020) achieving training loss ~0.51.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated faster-whisper STT (1.0–1.4s), Gemini intent classification (<500ms), TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup: 56.7→10.9 ms, 17.6→92 FPS vs eager PyTorch) for visual servoing, and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors (camera range-gate + gripper-ToF-triggered close at 25 mm) for contact-aware grasping via TCA9548A I2C mux.
